sessions.title: FRIDAY | SUP (Stand Up Paddle Board) Yoga w/Arlene Koby ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pond) 4:00PM-5:00PM
sessions.description: Stand Up Paddle Board Yoga is a fun way to connect with nature and challenge yourself. This class isn’t a typical yoga flow or about “perfect” alignment—it’s about centering yourself, having fun, tapping into creativity and nature, and laughing if you fall in the water. We’ll start with a 10–15 minute land lesson on how to paddle board, then take a short paddle out to our practice spot. Once anchored, we’ll meditate for about five minutes and move through a slow, intentional flow with breath. We’ll finish with a floating Savasana before paddling back to shore. There will be modifications and opportunities to challenge yourself, but the most important thing is to smile and have fun. Knowing how to swim is highly recommended. PFD life vests will be provided.

sessions.title: FRIDAY | SUP (Stand Up Paddle Board) Yoga w/Arlene Koby ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pond) 5:30PM-6:30PM

sessions.title: FRIDAY | Slackline Yoga & AcroYoga Sampler w/The YogaSlackers 5:30PM-6:30PM
sessions.description: A fun introduction to both practices. Students get to experience slackline yoga and beginner acroyoga in one session, making it easy to discover what interests them before the full weekend.

sessions.title: FRIDAY EVENING|Sunset Floating Sound Bliss: Eve of the Festival w/Ananda Priti ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pool) 6:45PM-7:45PM
sessions.description: Before the festival begins — the magic starts here. 🌅 Tonight is your invitation to arrive fully. To leave the drive, the week, the world behind — and step into something truly sacred before the festival even opens its doors. As the sun sets over the Catskill Mountains settle onto your float, wrapped in a cozy blanket, and let the evening carry you. Ananda Priti guides you through a gentle breathwork opening as the sky shifts from gold to indigo above you. From there the live healing sounds of gongs, crystal and brass singing bowls and chimes weave through the night air — washing over you, grounding you and opening you to everything this weekend has in store. 🌊 The stars begin to appear. The crickets join in. The mountains hold you close. And you remember why you came. ✨ This is not just the night before the festival. This is where your journey begins. Come open. Come ready. Come as you are. 🌙

sessions.title: FRIDAY EVENING|Sunset Floating Sound Bliss: Eve of the Festival w/Ananda Priti ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pool) 8:00PM-9:00PM

sessions.title: Sunrise Floating Sound Bliss w/Ananda Priti ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pool) 8:00AM-8:50AM
sessions.description: Begin your festival the way nature intended — in stillness, on the water, as the morning sun rises around you. 🌅 Join us at 8AM for a truly magical start to your day. Settle onto your float, wrapped in a cozy blanket, as Ananda Priti guides you through a gentle morning meditation and breathwork to open your body, clear your mind and set your intentions for the day ahead. From there the healing sounds of live gongs, crystal and brass singing bowls and chimes will carry you into a place of deep peace and pure presence. The water beneath you. The morning air around you. The mountains holding you. And the sound healing you. 🌊 There is no better way to open a festival than from a place of complete stillness and surrender. Come as you are. Leave transformed. ✨

sessions.title: Grounded Grace: Beginner Aerial Restorative w/Nancy Forstbauer (Farrell Center Dance Studio) 8:00AM-9:00AM
sessions.description: Step into a calm, nurturing space where movement meets surrender. In this low silk, beginner-friendly aerial yoga class, Nancy guides you through simple, slow, and soft movements designed to restore balance and ease. The low-hanging silks offer gentle support, allowing you to explore trust, release tension, and connect deeply with your body. Each class invites you to honor your unique rhythm — there’s no rush, no expectation, just the freedom to listen to your intuition and make the practice truly yours. Perfect for all levels, especially those new to aerial yoga or seeking a mindful, restorative experience. This style of yoga is done in a soft fabric hammock elevated above the ground about 3 or 4 feet. In contrast to a traditional yoga class where we use strength to hold our poses. Aerial yoga is about learning how to let go within the posture. The hammock is used to make inversions more accessible by alleviating back and neck compression. It also aligns the spine and decompresses the joints of the body.

sessions.title: Ebb & Flow w/Festival Coordinator Raegan Reed (Middlefield Nook) 8:00AM-9:00AM
sessions.description: By definition, ebb and flow means; a recurrent or rhythmical pattern of coming and going or decline and regrowth. This expression makes reference to the regular movement of the tides, where ebb means move away from the land and flow move back towards it. Like an ocean wave, we will start low and slow, we will pick up momentum midway and we will flow back down. In this class, you will experience twists, turns, deep stretching, a deep focus on alignment and breath, yummy hands on adjustments and much more! All levels welcome and encouraged! Modifications will be offered and everyone can move at their own pace.

sessions.title: Foundations of Slackline Yoga w/The YogaSlackers (Green Space) 8:00AM-9:00AM
sessions.description: For the YogaSlackers, the slackline is a thin yoga mat—a place to bring your practice into a new environment and discover what remains when the ground becomes less predictable. The line does more than challenge balance; it distills the concentration required for meditation, bringing you fully into the present moment. During this class, we will explore five different ways to connect with the slackline, offering accessible progressions so every participant can find at least one pose in which they feel stable and confident. Whether you are an experienced yogi, a seasoned slackliner, or completely new to both, there will be something for you to explore. Our poses are playful, approachable, and adaptable to different bodies and experience levels.

sessions.title: Yoga for Runners w/Selena Reynolds (Farrell Center Small Dance Studio) 8:00AM-9:00AM
sessions.description: Yoga and running are deeply complementary practices. Both build strength and focus, support resilience, and cultivate calm. Each offers long‑proven health benefits that balance the demands of modern life. Running develops cardiovascular endurance and the locomotion stamina many of us don’t get day‑to‑day. Yoga provides the stress relief and mental clarity needed to counter constant busy‑ness and overstimulation. This practice centers on flexibility and recovery for the muscle groups runners rely on most: hips, hamstrings, calves, and quads. We’ll also highlight feet, joint stability, and core strength to support longevity and reduce injury risk. Class concludes with breathwork and relaxation to enhance endurance, expand lung capacity, and cultivate peace of mind—on the mat, on the trail, and in daily life. (Asana‑focused; all levels welcome.)

sessions.title: Outdoor Floating Sound bath w/Ananda Priti ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pool) 9:30AM-10:20AM
sessions.description: Experience ultimate relaxation as you float in a serene pool on a comfortable raft, immersed in the soothing sounds of a continuous sound bath by Ananda Priti. This float will be OUTSIDE, weather permitting. Ananda, a talented sound healer, creates a harmonious atmosphere with crystal singing bowls that resonate beautifully, promoting deep relaxation and inner peace. The gentle rocking of the water enhances this transformative journey of self-discovery and rejuvenation. Designed as a sanctuary for well-being, this event invites you to let go of stress and embrace the healing power of music and water. Floating rafts will be available for you to be assisted onto and off of. You'll receive a cozy blanket, a head pillow, and an eye mask for a fully immersive experience. (A lifeguard will be present to ensure your safety throughout.)

sessions.title: Happy Back: Yoga Trapeze w/Nancy Forstbauer (Farrell Center Dance Studio) 9:30AM - 10:30AM
sessions.description: Give your spine the care it deserves in this dynamic Yoga Trapeze class. Experience the benefits of the yoga trapeze in this supportive yet strengthening class designed to decompress, mobilize, and stabilize the spine. Using the trapeze as a supportive and versatile training tool, you’ll combine functional strength exercises, core conditioning, spinal decompression, and supported stretching to create a healthier, more resilient back. You’ll safely explore spinal traction, increase flexibility, relieve tension, and enhance balance and body awareness and at the same time you’ll create space between the vertebrae, improve posture, and build the muscles that support a healthy back. This class is suitable for beginners and experienced practitioners alike, with modifications offered to meet individual needs. Leave class feeling taller, stronger, and refreshed with a spine that is both lengthened and strengthened.

sessions.title: Heart-Wide-Open Vinyasa Flow w/Selena Reynolds (Long Field A) 9:30AM-10:30AM
sessions.description: Join Selena for a heart-opening, energizing vinyasa flow. In yoga, we strive to remove any obstacles or blockages that prevent us from accessing our innate freedom of movement and being. This class will help release tension in the neck and shoulders and open the front body to move us into back bending postures with greater ease and joy. We will also learn how to strengthen the back body and use the core muscles to protect the lower back. Backbends are natural mood-lifters! Backbends also help us to access the full expression of our energy and vitality by breathing more fully! Come get heart-happier and sustainably back-bendier!!

sessions.title: AcroYoga: First Flight! w/The YogaSlackers (Long Field B) 9:30AM-10:30AM
sessions.description: In this beginner-friendly class, we will explore the YogaSlackers’ Five Principles of Acrobatics while helping participants experience their first flights. Through playful, accessible exercises, students will learn how to move, communicate, support one another, and build trust. No partner or previous experience is required! just a willingness to play, learn, and try something new.

sessions.title: TRAMPOLINE FUN - *JUMPSTART* Your Day with Bounce Basics w/ Sabrina Ursaner (Middlefield Nook) 9:30AM-10:30AM
sessions.description: *SPACE IS LIMITED! Sweat it out, bounce & dance to the beat, and JUMPstart your Catskill Mountain Yoga Festival experience with this amazingly fun cardio rebounding class on Jumpsport mini fitness trampolines. Rebounding classes are a great way to build muscle, balance, and endurance, all without hurting your joints: moderate-to-high-intensity with little-to-no impact! Plus they're so much fun you'll barely realize it's a full body workout. We are so excited to be offering trampoline classes this year. Learn form and technique, sweat a little, have FUN, and let go of whatever is weighing you down to soar to new heights in this exhilarating session suitable for beginners and ALL levels, including if this is your first time ever setting foot on a trampoline. *Space is extremely limited for this class. Be sure to register early.

sessions.title: Hike w/Gary Leahy, Semi-Strenuous (Meet at Registration) 9:30AM-10:30AM
sessions.description: Join Gary Leahy as we hike UP to the TOP of the Mountain behind SUNY Delhi. This hike will take 60 minutes to get up the mountain. From there, you can hike back down. Please wear sunscreen, sneakers and bring water.

sessions.title: Outdoor Floating Sound bath w/Ananda Priti ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pool) 11:00AM-11:50AM

(A lifeguard will be present to ensure your safety throughout.)

sessions.title: Happy Hips: Yoga Trapeze w/Nancy Forstbauer (Farrell Center Dance Studio) 11:00AM - 12:00PM
sessions.description: Unlock greater ease and mobility in your hips with this unique supportive Yoga Trapeze class designed to improve flexibility, strength, and range of motion. Using the trapeze as a tool for stability and gentle traction, you’ll explore movements that open the hips, release muscular tension, and strengthen the muscles that support healthy movements. Through a combination of dynamic stretches, controlled strengthening exercises, and mindful mobility work, you’ll improve hip flexibility, balance,and body awareness while creating more space and freedom throughout the lower body. Whether you’re looking to move with greater ease, reduce stiffness, improve athletic performance, move deeper in yoga postures, or simply reconnect with your body, this class will leave you feeling more open, balanced, and energized.

sessions.title: abunDANCE Movement Meditation Manifestation Practice w/Isha Justyna Kostek (Long Field A) 11:00AM-12:00PM
sessions.description: abunDANCE is a 60-minute movement meditation that guides you through the 7 Rhythms of Abundance: release, gratitude, joy, compassion, love, peace, and abundance. Through breath, music, and free-form dance, you embody each rhythm to clear blocks and awaken your natural flow. The practice is both grounding and uplifting, leaving you open, radiant, and aligned with manifestation.

sessions.title: Yin Yoga and Mythology w/Kelly Kamm (Long Field B) 11:00AM-12:00PM
sessions.description: Mythology has long been used to reflect the universal struggles of humankind. These folklore stories, told by and through relatable characters, help us feel more grounded and connected, so we can move through difficulties with grace, make friends with discomfort, and hold our center through uncertainty. Yin Yoga and Mythology combines rich storytelling traditions with powerful practices that are designed to offer physical, emotional, and mental relief, leaving you feeling ready to face the challenges of life with greater tenderness and ease.

sessions.title: EcoPrinting w/Marguerite Uhlmann-Bower (Meet at Registration) 11:00AM-12:00PM
sessions.description: Eco-Printing: A natural technique that honors Natures cycles by transferring plant and tree pigments onto paper or fabric. Learn a little. Harvest some. Co-create a lot. Take home surprising, healing, relatable plant patterns.

sessions.title: Slackro: AcroYoga Meets Slacklining w/The YogaSlackers (Green Space) 11:00AM-12:00PM
sessions.description: We know festival weekends are busy, and you have dozens of amazing classes to choose from. So why not experience two practices in one? In this unique class, we'll explore each pose three ways: first on the ground, then with a partner through AcroYoga, and finally on the slackline. You'll discover how each version builds on the next, revealing new insights into balance, alignment, communication, and focus. By experiencing the same movement in three different environments, you'll gain a deeper understanding of not only AcroYoga and Slackline Yoga, but also your yoga practice as a whole. The three disciplines complement one another in surprising ways, helping you develop greater body awareness, confidence, and presence. No experience is necessary, and no partner is required. If you've attended one of our other classes during the festival, don't worry - we'll be exploring a completely different set of poses, giving you a fresh experience while continuing to build your skills.

sessions.title: SUP (Stand Up Paddle Board) Yoga w/Jessie Murray ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pond) 1:00PM-1:50PM
sessions.description: SUP (stand up paddleboard) Yoga takes our practice off of our mats and out into the elements of nature. Moving our practice out onto the board on the water provides a higher level of mindfulness, of presence, and a deeper understanding and connection with the world around us. The paddle is short, the 30 minute yoga flow is deep, and the short reflective paddle back brings a feeling that will stay with you long after you come back to land. All classes are designed with all practitioners in mind, and no experience in paddling or yoga is necessary. All gear is provided and all that is required is your presence and an open heard and mind.

sessions.title: Grounded Grace: Beginner Aerial Restorative w/Nancy Forstbauer (Farrell Center Dance Studio) 1:00PM-2:00PM
sessions.description: Step into a calm, nurturing space where movement meets surrender. In this low silk, beginner-friendly aerial yoga class, Nancy guides you through simple, slow, and soft movements designed to restore balance and ease. The low-hanging silks offer gentle support, allowing you to explore trust, release tension, and connect deeply with your body. Each class invites you to honor your unique rhythm — there’s no rush, no expectation, just the freedom to listen to your intuition and make the practice truly yours. Perfect for all levels, especially those new to aerial yoga or seeking a mindful, restorative experience. This style of yoga is done in a soft fabric hammock elevated above the ground about 3 or 4 feet. In contrast to a traditional yoga class where we use strength to hold our poses. Aerial yoga is about learning how to let go within the posture. The hammock is used to make inversions more accessible by alleviating back and neck compression. It also aligns the spine and decompresses the joints of the body.

sessions.title: Getting Upside Down: An AcroYoga Journey w/The YogaSlackers (Long Field A) 1:00PM-2:00PM
sessions.description: What if your headstands and other inversions became easier - not by working harder, but by practicing them with a partner? In this class, we'll explore how AcroYoga can accelerate your inversion journey by making inversions more accessible, more supportive, and more enjoyable for a wide variety of body types and abilities. Through partner-assisted progressions, you'll experience how sharing weight, receiving feedback, and building confidence together can transform skills that often feel intimidating into achievable milestones. Whether your goal is your first inversion or refining your technique, you'll leave with practical tools you can bring back to your solo practice. Expect a safe, encouraging environment focused on body awareness, alignment, and playful exploration. No AcroYoga experience is necessary, and no partner is required. Participants should be comfortable holding a plank for at least 30 seconds

sessions.title: Bhakti Flow: Vinyāsa & Prāṇāyāma w/Bibi Lorenzetti (Farrell Center Small Dance Studio) 1:00PM-2:00PM
sessions.description: Movement as meditation. Breath as the thread that holds it all together. This class moves through a full arc — from a gentle warm-up into the heat of Sūrya Namaskāra, standing and seated postures, backbends, and inversions — closing in deep rest. Rigorous and rhythmic, grounding and opening at once. The prāṇāyāma woven throughout is not an add-on. It is the practice. When the breath leads, the mind follows. That is the whole point. Bibi Lorenzetti's Vinyasa roots run deep — shaped by over a decade of teaching in New York City at The Shala Yoga House, one of the most respected lineage-based studios in the city. Her classes carry that lineage: devotional, intelligent, and alive. All levels welcome.

sessions.title: Soul Restorative Yoga w/Sabrina Elmaliah (Long Field B) 1:00PM-2:00PM
sessions.description: Come to rest and restore from the hustle of modern life, weary traveler. Your next steps to bliss begin with deep, long stretching for a melting like butter on pancakes, stress-relieving experience. Together we will weave detoxifying poses with ancient yogic wisdoms for a revitalizing, fulfilling class, that brings participants into clear tranquility and communion. Reset & return to your life feeling supported and blissful!

sessions.title: Laugh, Breathe & Connect Through Laughter Yoga w/The Laughing Lovebugs (Middlefield Nook) 1:00PM-2:00PM
sessions.description: Join Laughing Lovebugs for an uplifting, interactive laughter yoga experience designed to help participants reconnect with joy, reduce stress, and build connection through playful movement, breathwork, mindfulness, and intentional laughter exercises. This all-levels wellness workshop blends laughter yoga, guided breathing techniques, light movement, group connection activities, grounding mindfulness, and relaxation practices to create an energizing yet accessible experience for all bodies and experience levels. Participants can expect: Guided laughter yoga exercises Breathwork and stress-relief techniques Playful interactive connection activities Gentle movement and mindfulness Emotional Regulation and Emotional Release A welcoming, inclusive environment focused on joy and wellness. No yoga experience, flexibility, or special equipment is needed.

sessions.title: Plant Walk & Identification w/Marguerite Uhlmann-Bower (Meet in Clark Parking Lot) 1:00PM - 2:00PM
sessions.description: "Reclaiming Ancient Wisdom for Modern Times" w/Marguerite Uhlmann-Bower. Join the Radical Herbalist, Earth Medicine Walker and retired nurse for an informing outdoors plant walk in one’s self-help journey. Re-learn associations and patterns that radically change foraging methods which also help us remember our TEK’ie skill-set in a relational re-languaging way. Learn about key sacred and everyday Plants as helpers and healers. Food, medicine, ritual.

sessions.title: SUP (Stand Up Paddle Board) Yoga w/Jessie Murray ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pond) 2:30PM - 3:20PM
sessions.description: SUP (stand up paddleboard) Yoga takes our practice off of our mats and out into the elements of nature. Moving our practice out onto the board on the water provides a higher level of mindfulness, of presence, and a deeper understanding and connection with the world around us. The paddle is short, the 30 minute yoga flow is deep, and the short reflective paddle back brings a feeling that will stay with you long after you come back to land. All classes are designed with all practitioners in mind, and no experience in paddling or yoga is necessary. All gear is provided and all that is required is your presence and an open heard and mind.

sessions.title: Solar Invocation: The Fire of Becoming ; Kundalini style flow class | Breathwork | Mantra w/Sarah Brianna (Long Field A) 2:30PM-3:30PM
sessions.description: A ritual of empowerment for the solar plexus… Your inner sun. We’ll work with Ayurvedic fire (agni), solar breath, and heart-forward flow to awaken confidence, willpower, and creative radiance. Expect candlelight, breath of fire, and an invocation to Surya… The source of illumination within and without.

sessions.title: Mythical Vinyasa Master Class w/Kelly Kamm (Long Field B) 2:30PM-3:30PM
sessions.description: Join Kelly Kamm for a spirited journey through Hindu myths, as well as the mantras, mudras and poses that go with them. Myths are like prisms, reflecting us back to ourselves and providing meaningful clues to help us through challenging moments in our lives. Coupled with creative vinyasa flow, the stories truly come to life with YOU as the main character! Krishna, Lakshmi, Kali, Shiva, Ganesha… any one of them (or more than one) might make an appearance as we flow through creative vinyasa sequences designed to unleash your inner deity! For all levels, this workshop includes storytelling, chanting, mudra (yoga for your hands), meditation and lots of inspired movement on the mat.

sessions.title: In the Middle Lies the Magic: A Nervous System–Informed Approach to Growth and Healing w/Emily Tomlinson (Middlefield Nook) 2:30PM-3:30PM
sessions.description: Find your center where strength meets softness and challenge meets support. Through mindful movement and breath, we’ll explore how “teaching to the middle” supports physical alignment and nervous system harmony. Rooted in both anatomy and awareness, this approach invites every practitioner to leave feeling grounded, open, and connected to their capacity for growth and healing.

sessions.title: Rollin' with my FOAMIES: Foam Rolling and Self-Myofascial Release w/Sabrina Ursaner (Middlefield Nook) 2:30PM-3:30PM
sessions.description: Rolling with my FOAMIES: Unwind and reset in this soothing class using foam rolling* techniques to release tension, ease muscle soreness, and promote deep relaxation. Through mindful movements and gentle pressure, you'll experience a full-body reset that calms the nervous system and melts away stress. Ideal for anyone needing relief from tightness or looking to simply relax, this session will leave you feeling refreshed, restored, and ready for a peaceful evening ahead. Rollga® foam rollers will be provided for use during this class No experience whatsoever is needed.

sessions.title: Yoga Core w/Arlene Koby (Farrell Center Dance Studio) 2:30PM-3:30PM
sessions.description: Ignite your 3rd Chakra and tap into your power center in this hybrid class which combines Core strengthening and Yoga. This class utilizes bands and blocks for resistance. All moves will be targeted to strengthen the core, back legs and arms. Expect traditional yoga poses for warm up and cool down.

sessions.title: 75-Minute Headstands, Arm Balances & Other Ways to Float w/The YogaSlackers (Farrell Center Small Dance Studio) 2:30PM-3:45PM
sessions.description: Explore the many ways your yoga practice can leave the ground for 75 MINUTES! In this class, we will work toward creating more lift, balance, and control in headstand, arm balances, jump-throughs, and jump-backs. Whether your goal is to get your feet off the floor for the first time, improve your airtime in an arm balance, or bring more lightness into your vinyasa transitions, you will learn practical techniques to help you float with greater confidence. We will focus on weight shifts, core engagement, shoulder stability, timing, and efficient movement rather than relying on strength alone. Accessible progressions will be offered for different experience levels. No inversion experience is necessary.

sessions.title: SUP (Stand Up Paddle Board) Yoga w/Jessie Murray ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pond) 4:00PM - 4:50PM
sessions.description: SUP (stand up paddleboard) Yoga takes our practice off of our mats and out into the elements of nature. Moving our practice out onto the board on the water provides a higher level of mindfulness, of presence, and a deeper understanding and connection with the world around us. The paddle is short, the 30 minute yoga flow is deep, and the short reflective paddle back brings a feeling that will stay with you long after you come back to land. All classes are designed with all practitioners in mind, and no experience in paddling or yoga is necessary. All gear is provided and all that is required is your presence and an open heard and mind.

sessions.title: "Discover Your Meditation Practice" w/Robert Napolitano (Farrell Center Dance Studio) 4:00PM-5:00PM
sessions.description: Explore six powerful meditation techniques rooted in yogic traditions and modern mental practices. Experience each approach firsthand—from breathwork and mantra to chakra meditation, inner sound, and guided visualization—so you can discover the practices that resonate most with you.

sessions.title: Hanumān Chālīsā - A Workshop w/Bibi Lorenzetti (Farrell Center Small Dance Studio) 4:00PM-5:00PM
sessions.description: Even though it looks like we are going outward — toward something, reaching for something — all of these practices are really about removing what covers what is already there. Written by Tulsi Das, the Chālīsā is forty verses — forty seed mantras — each a complete transmission. Hanumān is the symbol of our forgotten potency: kindness, courage, devotion, the power of love. Qualities already within us, buried under the weight of the kleshas. He reminds us we already have what we need. We just need to be reminded. We will chant through the Chālīsā together, explore what we are asking for when we chant it, and begin to develop a personal relationship with the practice. No prior chanting experience necessary. Come as you are.

sessions.title: Transformational Breathwork w/Ananda Priti (Long Field A) 4:00PM-5:00PM
sessions.description: Ready for a transformative journey? Join Ananda Priti, an expert in Transformational Breathwork, and discover the healing power of your breath. As you breathe deeply, you’ll nourish your body, uplift your spirit, and enhance your mental clarity. Feel the rush of oxygen revitalizing your cells and promoting holistic health! You'll gain insights into the therapeutic benefits of breathwork and receive step-by-step guidance on this life-changing technique. Rest assured, you’ll be supported as you explore your inner landscapes and uncover patterns contributing to emotional or physical challenges. This breathwork practice helps release stored tension, emotions, and trauma, activating your body's natural healing abilities. Embrace this opportunity to unlock a healthier, more vibrant you through the transformative power of your breath!

sessions.title: Closing the Portal: Sound Bath Journey w/Jennifer Carlin (Long Field B) 4:00PM-5:00PM
sessions.description: To complete the day’s festivities, we’ll gather for a restorative Sound Journey. Rest and receive vibration, deepen your connection to the land, and create space for the day's wisdom and inspiration to take root. Leave feeling calm, clear, and connected. Everyone welcome!

sessions.title: Yin Yoga and Live Flute Sound Bath w/Dana Humphrey (Middlefield Nook) 4:00PM-5:00PM
sessions.description: Experience a calming and immersive Yin Yoga and Live Flute Sound Bath led by Dana Humphrey and Musician & Certified Sound Therapist Onel Mulet. This session blends gentle yin postures with live meditative flute music to create a deeply restorative atmosphere. Attendees can expect a slow, grounding practice designed to release tension, support deep relaxation, and encourage mindfulness, creativity, and emotional ease. The combination of yin yoga and live sound offers a peaceful opportunity to slow down, breathe deeply, and reconnect with yourself in a new and meaningful way.

sessions.title: Sunset SUP (Stand Up Paddle Board) Yoga w/Arlene Koby & Jessie Murray ($15.00 additional fee) (In the Pond) 6:00PM-7:00PM
sessions.description: Led by two incredible paddleboard instructors, Arlene & Jessie Experience Stand Up Paddleboard (SUP) Yoga as we take the practice off the mat and onto the water, inviting deeper mindfulness, presence, and connection with nature. This sunset session blends gentle movement, creativity, and play — and yes, even laughing if you fall in. We’ll close with a floating Savasana as the sun sets, followed by a reflective paddle back to shore — a feeling that stays with you long after you return to land. Modifications and challenges are offered throughout, but the heart of the class is simple: smile, breathe, and enjoy the moment. This class is the perfect way to end off festival day!

sessions.title: SUNDAY MORNING | Handstands On People (2 Hour AcroYoga Workshop) w/The YogaSlackers (The Cardio Club) 10:00AM-12:00PM
sessions.description: What if the easiest place to learn a handstand wasn't the floor? In this extended workshop, we'll explore how AcroYoga can make handstands more accessible by using a partner as a stable, supportive foundation. You'll learn a variety of partner-assisted handstand shapes and progressions that build confidence, improve alignment, and help you spend more quality time upside down than you might on your own. A major focus of this workshop is spotting. Whether you're a yoga teacher looking to become a better spotter or simply someone who wants to help friends practice safely, you'll gain practical techniques you can immediately apply both on and off the mat. While this workshop builds naturally on concepts introduced in our weekend classes, everyone is welcome, even if this is your first class with us. No partner is required. Come discover that sometimes the best way to stand on your own hands… is to start on someone else's.
